changes.change: The Liger loss pads the 32,003-row head to a multiple of 64 with a -inf bias, so its GEMMs use aligned tensor-core kernels instead of unaligned sm75 fallbacks (about 18% of kernel time).
Deterministic mode no longer fills newly allocated empty tensors (about 5% of kernel time); gradients were verified bitwise identical with and without the fill, eager and compiled.

boundary: Single-GPU synthetic compute-mode measurements on the local card; each is one run of 30 timed steps (6 for the parent). They show relative gains only; GH200 rates come from the qualification packet.
